bullets.text: Anbumani Ramadoss warned that building a boundary wall over the Pallikaranai marshland will cause a major disaster.
Residents in Chennai and its suburbs suffered prolonged power outages over the weekend, according to TNPDCL reports.
Drivers Kavin and others narrowly escaped after their car suddenly caught fire at midnight in Velachery Thandeeswaram Nagar.
The state highways department is desilting and clearing three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai to flood-proof Velachery.
The Madras High Court heard a case regarding the National Green Tribunal ban on construction around the Pallikaranai marshland.
TANGEDCO scheduled a five-hour power shutdown for maintenance affecting Ambattur, Tambaram, and Avadi on Sunday.
Residents in Poonamallee municipality faced distress due to frequent night-time power cuts in recent days.
Mahatama Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme workers protested at the Tiruttani BDO office over low wages.
Tamil Nadu is experiencing a significant resurgence in its Global Capability Centre sector with expansions and new setups.
Housing and Urban Development principal secretary R Kirlosh Kumar announced the upcoming SPEED AI-based planning approval software.
Youth Congress members were arrested in Chennai after releasing black balloons during the Prime Minister and Chief Minister visit.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss questioned why TVK continues to follow the political mistakes previously made by the DMK.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched and laid foundation stones for various development projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore in Chennai.
Chief Minister Vijay requested Prime Minister Modi to reconsider the proposed metro rail projects for Madurai and Coimbatore.
Passengers reported halved travel times and costs following the opening of the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail corridor.
